name: selfhost-remote-mail-mcp
description: Your own email inside Claude: search, read, draft and sort, in any mailbox that supports IMAP.
long_description:
Puts your own mailboxes inside Claude Desktop. Claude can search and read your email, write drafts, sort, archive and, if you allow it, send. It runs on this computer. Your passwords stay here, encrypted.

**After installing:** open the settings page at http://localhost:8765/settings, type the passphrase you chose here, and add your mailbox (any mailbox that supports IMAP; most need an app password). Then start a new chat.

The same settings page adds more mailboxes (up to 5, each full, draft only or read only), signatures, add-ons such as Calendar, and privacy options.

Guides: https://github.com/s17sh70x2jfl031ag/Selfhost-Remote-Mail-MCP/blob/main/docs/claude-desktop-extension.md

tools.name: accounts
tools.description: Lists your mailboxes, their modes and the settings page address

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches emails with simple filters like from:sam is:unread

tools.name: attachment
tools.description: Opens an attachment: pictures, PDFs and text

tools.name: draft
tools.description: Writes a draft: new email, reply, reply to all or forward

tools.name: action
tools.description: Archives, moves, deletes to Trash, marks read or unread, pins

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email, only in mailboxes set to full

tools.name: contacts
tools.description: Lists the people you write to

tools.name: upload_link
tools.description: Gives a one-time link to upload a file to attach

tools.name: settings
tools.description: Shows the settings and the settings page address

tools.name: change_setting
tools.description: Changes a setting, like a mailbox's signature

passphrase.title: Passphrase for your settings page (12+ characters)
passphrase.description: Make one up: 12 or more characters. It locks your settings page at http://localhost:8765/settings, where you add your mailbox. Save it in your password manager. If you set one up with this server before, type that one.

keep_running.title: Keep the settings page running when Claude is closed
keep_running.description: On: it starts when you log in, so scheduled emails go out and add-ons work even when Claude Desktop is closed (Mac and Linux). Off: it only runs while Claude Desktop is open.
